instruction.text: Rearrange the formula converting temperature from degrees Celsius (°C) to degrees Fahrenheit (°F) to make C the subject. Write your answer in its simplest form.
instruction.sound: Rearrange the formula converting temperature from degrees Celsius to degrees Fahrenheit to make C the subject. Write your answer in its simplest form.

trainers.instruction: What is the temperature in degrees Celcius if it is 50° Fahrenheit?

instruction.text: A theme park charges £20 per visitor and has expenses of £500 each day. Rearrange the formula to make 𝘱 the subject. Write your answer in its simplest form.

trainers.instruction: How many people visited the theme park if the total daily income was £14,500?

instruction.text: A pizza shop charges £10 for a large plain pizza and £1.50 for each type of topping. Each pizza is then cut into 8 slices. Rearrange the formula to make 𝘵 the subject. Write your answer in its simplest form.

trainers.instruction: How many types of toppings are on a pizza that costs £2 per slice?

instruction.text: A tennis club charges £26 for a monthly membership fee and a further £6 per training session. Rearrange the formula to make 𝘯 the subject. Write your answer in its simplest form.

trainers.instruction: How many training sessions did a member attend in a month if they paid £62?
